description: ICCS and National Technical University of Athens researchers publish a Mathematica model of Raman photon noise in a GPON fibre-to-the-home topology. The August 2022 release supplies a notebook, a topology figure and PDF documentation, freely available under CC BY 4.0. Users vary terminal counts, splitter ratios, drop and feeder lengths, optical filtering and single-photon-detector settings. The model returns expected forward and backward Raman-scattering count rates in counts per second, with gated or free-running detector modes. It can support optical-network design experiments and simulations of noise-sensitive services sharing fibre infrastructure. Coverage is a configurable generic topology, not measurements from a named operator or observation period. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. Required Mathematica version, additional dependencies, empirical calibration and numerical uncertainty remain unknown. The notebook was not executed, and use of the Mathematica runtime may require a separate licence.
